package main

// Writes the vectors that check how the Rust conformance driver binds a request against how this driver binds it. It is
// kept as text because it must be compiled inside the driver's package: rust/testdata/regenerate.sh copies it in as a
// test file, runs it and removes it again.
//
// Each row is one input, read as serve reads it (one decoder, unknown fields disallowed), and the outcome: "eof" when
// there is no value, "err" when the driver would exit, or "ok" and the request it bound, written by json.Marshal. No
// input holds invalid UTF-8 in a value, so the rows do not depend on how a release writes it.

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestWriteRustDriverVectors(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("DOST_RUST_VECTORS")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("DOST_RUST_VECTORS is not set")
	}
	if _, ok := reflect.TypeOf(request{}).FieldByName("Seed"); !ok {
		t.Skip("this driver has no test seam requests yet, and the rows cover them")
	}
	var inputs []string
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	add := func(s string) {
		if !seen[s] {
			seen[s] = true
			inputs = append(inputs, s)
		}
	}

	// What is not an object at all.
	for _, s := range []string{``, ` `, "\n\t", `null`, ` null `, `{}`, `[]`, `[null]`, `"op"`, `0`, `true`, `false`, `{`, `{"op"}`, `{"op":}`,
		`nul`, `{"op":"close"}x`, `{"op":"close"} {"op":"open"}`, `{"op":"a","op":"b"}`, `{"op":"a","op":null}`, `{"op":null,"op":"b"}`} {
		add(s)
	}

	names := []string{"op", "dir", "segmented", "node", "nodes", "topics", "items", "group", "offset", "next", "state", "records", "bytes",
		"floors", "dest", "discard_later", "topic", "partition", "key", "value", "id", "name", "version", "steps", "run", "queue", "input",
		"attrs", "lease_ms", "token", "failure", "step", "after", "limit", "start", "seed", "nanoseconds", "point", "kill", "skip"}
	values := []string{`null`, `true`, `false`, `0`, `-0`, `1`, `-1`, `7`, `255`, `256`, `1.0`, `1e2`, `9223372036854775807`, `9223372036854775808`,
		`-9223372036854775808`, `-9223372036854775809`, `18446744073709551615`, `18446744073709551616`, `""`, `"x"`, `"aGk="`, `"aGk"`, `"aG k="`,
		`"aGk=\n"`, `"aGl="`, `"<&> "`, `[]`, `[null]`, `[null,null]`, `[1,2,3]`, `[0,255]`, `[256]`, `[-1]`, `[1.0]`, `["a"]`, `["a",null,"b"]`,
		`[1,"a"]`, `[[]]`, `[{}]`, `[{},null]`, `{}`, `{"a":1}`, `{"a":"b"}`, `{"a":null}`, `{"a":1,"a":2,"b":3}`, `{"a":"x","a":null}`,
		`[{"topic":"t","key":"k","value":"aGk=","id":"i"}]`, `[{"topic":"t","partition":2,"floor":9}]`,
		`[{"kind":"activity","name":"n","attempts":3,"backoff_ms":10}]`, `[{"value":[104,105]}]`, `[{"nope":1}]`, `[{"TOPIC":"t"}]`}
	for _, n := range names {
		for _, v := range values {
			add(`{"` + n + `":` + v + `}`)
		}
	}

	// Names that match only when folded, and names that do not match.
	for _, n := range names {
		for _, k := range []string{strings.ToUpper(n), strings.ToUpper(n[:1]) + n[1:], strings.ReplaceAll(n, "s", "ſ"), strings.ReplaceAll(n, "k", "K"),
			strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ToUpper(n), "S", "ſ"), strings.ReplaceAll(n, "i", "ı"), strings.ReplaceAll(n, "i", "İ"),
			strings.ReplaceAll(n, "_", "-"), n + " ", " " + n, n + "\u0000", strings.ReplaceAll(n, "e", "е"), strings.ReplaceAll(n, "a", "ａ")} {
			add(`{"` + strings.ReplaceAll(k, "\u0000", `\u0000`) + `":null}`)
		}
	}
	for _, s := range []string{`{"ſkip":3,"Kill":true,"KEY":"k"}`, `{"Op":"a","OP":"b","op":"c","oP":"d"}`, `{"op":"c","OP":"d"}`,
		`{"items":[{"Key":"k","TOPIC":"t","Id":"i","VALUE":[1]}]}`, `{"floors":[{"FLOOR":1,"Partition":2,"topicı":"x"}]}`,
		`{"steps":[{"Kind":"k","BACKOFF_Mſ":4,"attemptſ":2}]}`, `{"�op":1}`, `{"op":"x"}`, `{"":1}`} {
		add(s)
	}

	// A key given more than once: Go binds each occurrence onto what the earlier ones left.
	arrays := map[string][]string{
		"nodes":   {`null`, `[]`, `["a"]`, `["a","b","c"]`, `[null]`, `[null,null]`, `[null,null,null,null]`, `["z",null]`},
		"items":   {`null`, `[]`, `[{"topic":"a","key":"k","value":"aGk=","id":"i"}]`, `[{"topic":"b"},{"key":"l","value":[1,2,3]},{"id":"j"}]`, `[null]`, `[{},{}]`, `[null,null,null,null]`, `[{"value":[null,null]}]`, `[{"value":null},{"value":[9]}]`, `[{"value":[]},{"value":[null,null,null,null]}]`},
		"floors":  {`null`, `[]`, `[{"topic":"a","partition":1,"floor":2}]`, `[{"floor":5},{"partition":6},{"topic":"c"}]`, `[null,null]`, `[{},{},{},{}]`},
		"steps":   {`null`, `[]`, `[{"kind":"a","name":"n","attempts":1,"backoff_ms":2}]`, `[{"name":"m"},{"attempts":7}]`, `[null,null,null]`, `[{}]`},
		"value":   {`null`, `[]`, `""`, `"aGk="`, `"AQIDBAU="`, `[1,2,3]`, `[9]`, `[null]`, `[null,null]`, `[null,null,null,null,null,null]`, `[7,null,8]`},
		"state":   {`null`, `"aGk="`, `[1,2,3]`, `[null,null,null]`, `[]`},
		"input":   {`null`, `"e30="`, `[123,125]`, `[null]`, `[null,null,null]`},
		"failure": {`null`, `"eA=="`, `[1]`, `[null,null]`},
		"topics":  {`null`, `{}`, `{"a":1}`, `{"a":2,"b":3}`, `{"a":null}`, `{"b":null,"c":4}`},
		"attrs":   {`null`, `{}`, `{"a":"x"}`, `{"a":"y","b":"z"}`, `{"a":null}`},
		"op":      {`null`, `"a"`, `"b"`, `""`},
		"offset":  {`null`, `1`, `2`, `0`},
		"kill":    {`null`, `true`, `false`},
		"seed":    {`null`, `1`, `18446744073709551615`},
	}
	for _, n := range []string{"nodes", "items", "floors", "steps", "value", "state", "input", "failure", "topics", "attrs", "op", "offset", "kill", "seed"} {
		vs := arrays[n]
		for _, a := range vs {
			for _, b := range vs {
				add(`{"` + n + `":` + a + `,"` + n + `":` + b + `}`)
				add(`{"` + n + `":` + a + `,"` + strings.ToUpper(n) + `":` + b + `}`)
				for _, c := range vs {
					add(`{"` + n + `":` + a + `,"` + n + `":` + b + `,"` + n + `":` + c + `}`)
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// Longer chains for the fields whose spare elements can come back.
	add(`{"value":[1,2,3,4,5],"value":[9],"value":[null,null,null],"value":[8,null],"value":[null,null,null,null,null,null,null]}`)
	add(`{"value":"AQIDBAU=","value":[9],"value":[null,null,null,null,null,null]}`)
	add(`{"value":[1,2,3],"value":"","value":[null,null,null]}`)
	add(`{"value":[1,2,3],"value":[],"value":[null,null,null]}`)
	add(`{"value":[1,2,3],"value":null,"value":[null,null,null]}`)
	add(`{"items":[{"topic":"a","value":[1,2,3]},{"topic":"b","key":"k"},{"topic":"c"}],"items":[{"value":[9]}],"items":[{"value":[null,null,null]},{"id":"i"},null,null]}`)
	add(`{"nodes":["a","b","c","d","e"],"nodes":["z"],"nodes":[null,null,"y"],"nodes":[null,null,null,null,null,null]}`)
	add(`{"floors":[{"topic":"a","partition":1,"floor":2},{"topic":"b","partition":3,"floor":4}],"floors":[null],"floors":[{"floor":7},{"floor":8},{"floor":9}]}`)

	// Whole requests as the suites send them.
	for _, s := range []string{
		`{"op":"open","dir":"store","segmented":true,"node":"a","nodes":["a","b"],"topics":{"events":1,"other":3}}`,
		`{"op":"publish","topic":"events","partition":0,"key":"k","value":"aGk=","id":"i"}`,
		`{"op":"publish_batch","items":[{"topic":"events","key":"","value":"cjA=","id":"r0"},{"topic":"other","value":"","id":""}]}`,
		`{"op":"commit_batch","topic":"events","partition":0,"group":"g","offset":0,"next":5,"state":"Zml2ZQ==","items":[]}`,
		`{"op":"retain","records":10,"bytes":1000,"floors":[{"topic":"events","partition":0,"floor":7}]}`,
		`{"op":"repair","dir":"store","discard_later":true}`, `{"op":"backup","dest":"copy"}`,
		`{"op":"wf_register","name":"n","version":2,"steps":[{"kind":"activity","name":"a","attempts":3,"backoff_ms":10}]}`,
		`{"op":"wf_start_once","run":"r","name":"n","version":2,"input":"e30=","attrs":{"k":"v"}}`,
		`{"op":"wf_poll","queue":"q","lease_ms":5000}`, `{"op":"wf_finish","run":"r","token":"t","step":1,"failure":"eA=="}`,
		`{"op":"wf_history","run":"r","after":3,"limit":10}`, `{"op":"fix_inputs","start":-5,"step":7,"seed":18446744073709551615}`,
		`{"op":"advance","nanoseconds":5}`, `{"op":"arm","point":"segment.write","kill":true,"skip":-1}`, `{"op":"disarm"}`,
		"{\n \"op\" : \"close\"\n}\n", `{"op":"close","surprise":1}`, `{"op":"close","surprise":null}`,
	} {
		add(s)
	}

	var b strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&b, "# written by %s with rust/testdata/driver_vectors_test.go.txt; do not edit\n", runtime.Version())
	counts := map[string]int{}
	for _, in := range inputs {
		requests := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader([]byte(in)))
		requests.DisallowUnknownFields()
		var q request
		verdict := "ok"
		if err := requests.Decode(&q); err == io.EOF {
			verdict = "eof"
		} else if err != nil {
			verdict = "err"
		}
		counts[verdict]++
		line := "-" + hex.EncodeToString([]byte(in)) + "- " + verdict
		if verdict == "ok" {
			bound, err := json.Marshal(q)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			line += " " + string(bound)
		}
		b.WriteString(line + "\n")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "driver-requests-go.txt"), []byte(b.String()), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("driver-requests-go.txt: %d rows (%d ok, %d err, %d eof)", len(inputs), counts["ok"], counts["err"], counts["eof"])
}
